[RFCS.7a.3] `FactWithdraw` is **compare** class ([RFCS.3.4]) — re-derived and
byte-compared, never delivered to the engine, on the same reasoning as
`[RFCS.6a.3]`.

A reader must treat a `FactWithdraw` whose `fact_id` matches no `FactEmit` **or**
`FactAssert` in the current file as a fatal stream error. The engine may
withdraw a fact the integrator asserted (a TTL expiry does not care who
asserted it), so unlike `[RFCS.7.3]` this rule spans both producers.
